tools.name: list_sync_accounts
tools.when_to_use: List each supplier account's sync state (kind, mode, interval, last requested, next due, status never/ok/overdue) for monitoring.
tools.when_not_to_use: You want to force a sync now (use trigger_sync). Operational fields only — no credentials or financial terms.

tools.name: trigger_sync
tools.when_to_use: Manually request an immediate sync for one account (stages sync.job.requested); use when its data looks stale or overdue.
tools.when_not_to_use: The account is already syncing on schedule and its status is ok (check get_sync_accounts first).
